**maze** is a project in [Science and visualisation](@/projects/science.md). Its code is written mainly in [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md) (54.6 %), with [Elixir](@/glossary/elixir.md), [HTML](@/glossary/html.md) and [CSS](@/glossary/css.md).

The [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) was created on 18 November 2016; its latest [commit](@/glossary/commit.md) is from 20 November 2016. It reads “WIP”. With no commit in the last 48 months it is listed as archive: work from 2016, kept for the record and dated as measured.

Its source is on [GitHub](https://github.com/korczis/maze) and [GitLab](https://gitlab.com/korczis/maze).

Related work in [Science and visualisation](@/projects/science.md): [Oscilla](@/work/oscilla.md) (2026), [algoglyph](@/work/algoglyph.md) (2026), [maze-rs](@/work/maze-rs.md) (2016) and [haskell-world](@/work/haskell-world.md) (2016).
